scope: Measure the VUE down-arrow ROI during a 150 ms emulated left-button field override and verify post-test input/capture cleanup.

method.target: Visible enabled File Manager vertical down arrow, guest pointer hotspot over the arrow in the native frame.
method.field_override: field:set_value(1), held until a frame callback after 0.15 emulated seconds; snapshots taken before clear and after clear.
method.operation_reason: held for 150ms emulated; pre-clear and post-clear snapshots saved

result: The held and released captures are identical across the arrow/cursor ROI. The callback completed, but the raw mouse port was not sampled while the override was held. Therefore this result does not prove that the guest received a valid button edge and cannot establish the VUE held-arrow appearance.

cleanup.mame_window: Iconic, restored to the pre-test state

next: Do not infer a visual pressed state from this direct field override. The physical input route in R438 produced an observed button bit and scroll action on release; continue only with a fresh visible target and a longer held-state capture, while recording the raw bit at capture time.
